payload.text: pplr tags and pplr contact with no command print the legacy usage naming tags.py and contact.py (USAGE in src/tags.rs and src/contact.rs), files WP13 removes. Ruled a design D10 fix, at dc's ask for tags and vc's read of contact: it changes no data file and no tested output. Each usage names its pplr command, with its layout realigned and its exit status kept. A test pins each new text, so the fix stays. cc makes it one small commit in WP13's series, measured with the rest, and lists it in WP13's body as D10 requires. dc adds it to the CHANGELOG's Fixed. vc confirms D9's correction (318d065: edit out, cp only without -o) and ST0002's objective (53cfa89) against the code and the packaging.
